title: Longitudinal Sole Gliding
summary: The broad thumb pad glides along the sole from heel toward the forefoot.
goal: Gently work the longitudinal regions of the sole.
instructions: Glide the thumb pad along the sole.
Do not dig into painful points.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
